text:
```yaml
name: Deploy docs on main branch commits

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions: {}

jobs:
  paths-filter:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      docs_changed: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.docs_changed }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Detect docs changes
        id: filter
        uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        with:
          filters: |
            docs_changed:
              - 'docs/**'

  trigger-website-deploy:
    needs: paths-filter
    if: needs.paths-filter.outputs.docs_changed == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      secrets: read
    steps:
      - name: Trigger Vercel deploy
        run: |
          curl -s -X POST ${{ secrets.WEBSITE_VERCEL_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL }}
```
